title: CAR T cells show early promise in progressive multiple sclerosis
title_zh: CAR T细胞在进行性多发性硬化症中显示早期希望
abstract: Phase I trial data presented at MSToronto2026 indicate that the chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy azercabtagene zapreleucel (azer-cel) is safe and has the potential to improve outcomes in people with progressive multiple sclerosis.
abstract_zh: 在MSToronto2026会议上展示的I期试验数据表明，嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞疗法azercabtagene zapreleucel（azer-cel）安全性良好，并有潜力改善进行性多发性硬化症患者的预后。
snippet: Phase I trial data presented at MSToronto2026 indicate that the chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy azercabtagene zapreleucel (azer-cel) is safe and has the potential to improve outcomes in people with progressive multiple sclerosis.
